decisions.title: Binding agreed UI and the build C go

items.text: Update the climb with the agreed items; reviewers judge against the agreed UI. This message is the owner's yes to build C as the 4th pi-gen run.
items.quote: Okay let's do the thread migrate where we update the climb tuner plan with all these agreed items and climb to the new pi build. Same orchecstration, builders and reviewers as we have done in the recent past. Please don't deviate from UI we set and have the reviewers know what the app is supposed to look like so they judge against that not what they think is best.
